chunks: From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about a woman who sees blood during pregnancy. He said: She refrains for the days in which she used to menstruate; then if the blood exceeds the days in which she used to refrain, she should wait an additional three days, then after that she is in a state of istihadah.

key_terms.اسْتَظْهَرَتْ: she adds precautionary waiting time beyond her usual days
key_terms.تَحِيضُ: to menstruate; referring here to her usual menstrual cycle
key_terms.تَقْعُدُ: to refrain from acts such as salat due to menstrual bleeding
key_terms.مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ: a woman experiencing irregular non-menstrual bleeding

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pregnant woman who sees bleeding according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who sees blood. She observes the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, and if the bleeding continues beyond that, she adds three more days; after that, the blood is treated as istihadah.
